name: Norfenfluramine
summary: Norfenfluramine, or 3-trifluoromethylamphetamine, is a never-marketed drug of the amphetamine family and a major active metabolite of the appetite suppressants fenfluramine and benfluorex. The compound is a racemic mixture of two enantiomers with differing activities, dexnorfenfluramine and levonorfenfluramine.

pharmacology.text: Norfenfluramine acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent (SNRA) and as a potent serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptor agonist. Both enantiomers of norfenfluramine are active as monoamine releasing agents, although dexnorfenfluramine is more potent than levonorfenfluramine. Similarly, both enantiomers are active as serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonists, but dexnorfenfluramine is likewise more potent than levonorfenfluramine.

uses.text: Norfenfluramine, or 3-trifluoromethylamphetamine, is a never-marketed drug of the amphetamine family and a major active metabolite of the appetite suppressants fenfluramine and benfluorex.

sideEffects.en: It activates the 5-HT2B receptor, which is the action linked to heart valve damage and raised blood pressure in the lungs. Releasing serotonin can also cause nausea, headache and, at high exposure, serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它會活化 5-HT2B 受體，而這個作用與心臟瓣膜損傷及肺動脈高壓有關。釋放血清素也可能造成噁心、頭痛，暴露量高時還可能引發血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会活化 5-HT2B 受体，而这个作用与心脏瓣膜损伤及肺动脉高压有关。释放血清素也可能造成恶心、头痛，暴露量高时还可能引发血清素症候群。

fact.en: Its parent drug fenfluramine was part of the diet combination Fen-Phen, withdrawn in 1997 after it was linked to damaged heart valves, an effect now blamed largely on 5-HT2B receptor activation.
fact.zh: 它的母體藥物芬氟拉明是減肥藥組合 Fen-Phen 的成分，1997 年因與心臟瓣膜損傷有關而撤市，現在普遍認為這主要源自 5-HT2B 受體的活化。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体药物芬氟拉明是减肥药组合 Fen-Phen 的成分，1997 年因与心脏瓣膜损伤有关而撤市，现在普遍认为这主要源自 5-HT2B 受体的活化。
